dict.Grup ales de mână: bifezi categoriile ca: Manual group: tick the categories to be added up on a single row (for example North = Cluj + Iasi); the others stay on their own row
dict.Grupurile alese de mână merg cu un singu: Manual groups work with a single row field, with at least two categories, and without rank or "relative to the chosen item"
dict.Element calculat: un rând nou, sub categ: Calculated item: a new row, below the categories, with a formula from other rows (for example Cluj - Iasi = the difference between them); the Total row stays the total of the categories
dict.Elementele calculate merg doar cu un sin: Calculated items work only with a single row field, at most one column field and with values shown as numbers
dict.Formula cu numele categoriilor de pe rân: Formula with the names of the row categories (for example Cluj - Iasi), on each column of the summary. Names with spaces go between apostrophes. The Total row does not include it.
